page.content:
Kazuya and Jun's son — Tekken 3's new lead and later Zaibatsu head.

How Jin Kazama connects

  • Work: Tekken 3 — Tekken 3 made Jin Kazama the new lead against Ogre.
  • Work: Tekken 8 — Tekken 8 is built around Jin's final confrontation with Kazuya.
  • Concept: Devil Gene — Jin inherited the Devil Gene from Kazuya and Jun's line.
  • Character: Kazuya Mishima — Jin exists to end Kazuya — and the Mishima curse with him.
  • Character: Jun Kazama — Jin is Jun Kazama's son as much as he is a Mishima.
  • Faction: Mishima Zaibatsu — Jin later seized the Mishima Zaibatsu and declared war on the world.
  • Character: Heihachi Mishima — Jin turned on Heihachi after learning the family used him.
  • Concept: Mishima-style karate — Jin learned Mishima-style karate before mixing in Kazama and karate-do.
  • Character: Hwoarang — Hwoarang's rivalry with Jin began in Tekken 3 and never closed.
  • Location: Yakushima — Jin returns to Yakushima in Tekken 8 to face what the Devil Gene made him.
  • Character: Ling Xiaoyu — Xiaoyu keeps trying to pull Jin out of the Mishima war.

What is Jin Kazama?

Jin Kazama learned Mishima karate from Heihachi, then turned on both grandfather and father. He won Tekken 3, later seized the Mishima Zaibatsu, and remains the Devil Gene heir at the center of Tekken 8.

Key threads lead to Tekken 3, Tekken 8, Devil Gene, Kazuya Mishima, Jun Kazama and Mishima Zaibatsu.
